entities.name: SNX4
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed human UniProt O95219; 450 aa.
Sorting nexin involved in endocytosis, endocytic recycling, and autophagosome assembly through ATG9A trafficking.
Contains a PX domain at residues 100–183; PX domains mediate phosphoinositide-dependent membrane association.
Localizes to the cytoplasmic face of early endosome membranes and the endocytic recycling compartment.
Heterodimerizes with SNX7 or SNX30 and interacts with SNX32, WWC1/KIBRA, BIN1, and dynein-associated components.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass 51.9 kDa, theoretical pI 5.69, GRAVY -0.606, predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -10.4.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; function is consistent with a nonenzymatic trafficking adaptor/scaffold.

GO annotations include phosphatidylinositol and phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding, early endosome membrane, endocytic recycling, protein transport, and positive regulation of autophagosome assembly.

entities.name: PX domain
observations: Pfam PF00787 detected in SNX4 at residues 100–183 with i-Evalue 4.1e-21.
PX domain supports phosphoinositide-dependent membrane targeting, consistent with endosomal localization.

entities.name: Early endosome membrane
observations: SNX4 is annotated as a peripheral membrane protein on the cytoplasmic side of early endosome membranes and in the juxtanuclear endocytic recycling compartment.

entities.name: Endocytic recycling
observations: SNX4 promotes recycling of endocytosed transferrin receptor and participates in intracellular trafficking.

entities.name: Autophagosome assembly
observations: SNX4 contributes to autophagosome assembly by regulating trafficking and recycling of ATG9A.
